text: Based on the evidence, approximately 0.5 hectares of native forest were lost on this 17.6-hectare rural property in 2022. This represents about 3.41% of the entire property. The loss was corroborated by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map. The loss area was about 0.6 hectares, of which 0.5 hectares were identified as native forest.
